source(output(
		CSCS_ID as string,
		PDPD_ID as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		PLDS_DESC as string,
		BilledAmount as decimal(0,0),
		SBSB_ID as string,
		CSPI_ID as string,
		PayDueDate as string,
		GrpLocCd as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select  GRGR_ID ,	SBSB_ID ,	EBILL_EFF_DT,	EBILL_TERM_DT from INVOICE.GBD_EBILL_PREF',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBEBILLEXTRACT
SRCOLEDBEBILLEXTRACT sink(input(
		CSCS_ID as string,
		PDPD_ID as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		PLDS_DESC as string,
		BilledAmount as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		CSPI_ID as string,
		PAY_DUE_DATE as string,
		Grp_LocCd as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CSCS_ID,
		PDPD_ID,
		GRGR_ID,
		PLDS_DESC,
		BilledAmount,
		SBSB_ID,
		CSPI_ID,
		PAY_DUE_DATE = PayDueDate,
		Grp_LocCd = GrpLocCd)) ~> DSTFFEBILLEXTRACT
DFTDCNVFAML sink(input(
		{MIN(SUB_EFF)} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Copy of SUBSC_HCID} as string,
		{Copy of DEP_HCID} as string,
		{Copy of GRPBILLENTITY} as string,
		{Copy of SUB_GRGR_ID} as string,
		{MIN(DEP_EFF)} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{MAX(DEP_TERM)} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Copy of DEP_GRGR_ID} as string,
		{MAX(SUB_TERM)} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Copy of INVOICENBR} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> DSTXLSFAMLINACTIVE
